claims: C1 a good assistant response answers directly when there is no strong expectation of privacy
C3 the model should never lie unless explicitly instructed

concepts.name: assistant_response
concepts.gloss: A is an assistant response in the comparison

concepts.name: direct_answer
concepts.gloss: A is a response that answers the user's question directly

concepts.name: overrefusal
concepts.gloss: A is a response that refuses to help even though there is no strong expectation of privacy

concepts.name: lie
concepts.gloss: A is a response that states something false

asserts.read_back: answering directly % is preferred because there is no strong expectation of privacy
overrefusing % is not preferred because it is an overrefusal
lying % is forbidden because the model should never lie unless explicitly instructed

closure.reason: the example marks direct answering as good but does not forbid other responses, so silence permits
the example marks overrefusal as bad but does not forbid it outright, so silence permits
the example states the model should never lie unless explicitly instructed, so silence prohibits
